summary: Phase 4 adversarial probes of check-records.sh at c1e84b19, all new beyond the Review A falsification set (ID edit, extra 31st row, below-bar accepted on the Judge and mill Rerate paths, citation not touching the TSV, non-ancestor citation; none repeated). A shared clone under /tmp/opencode/adv-p4-civic holds the committed tree at the audited head c1e84b19dd1b6a73b9b5ac3c1f5dbe394f88c9be; the control passes 44 of 44, so every probe counts. Eight probe classes are caught with exact FAIL lines: a civic row set to follow-up while the inventory state stays accepted fails two P4-c checks (state-cell mismatch and accepted count 29 against supported 30); a status edit on the non-civic P0 row locations/adventure/dungeon fails P4-b on both diff lines; a trailing space in a status cell fails P4-a as an unknown status; a non-civic row reorder fails P4-b; a one-character generator drift (watermill x 2.2 to 2.3, the yaw line still -65) is caught by the P4-g byte compare alone while the yaw grep still passes; a one-byte append to docs/map-review.html fails P4-e; and a plan citation abbreviated to the 4-character sha e2c7, which does not resolve uniquely, makes all 30 changed slugs fail P4-d (the citation regex needs 7 to 40 characters, and e2c7bb9c is the only plan citation that touches the TSV, verified on the live tree). Four probes confirm checker gaps with no live instance, routed to Red as hardening Nits ADV-7 to ADV-9: a trailing tab in a status cell adds a fifth column and the checker still passes 44 of 44 (P4-a reads only the 4th field; the committed TSV holds no row with a column count other than 4); a pure reorder of two adjacent civic P2 rows passes 44 of 44 (P4-b compares sorted ID sets and per-line prefixes; base and head cut -f1-3 sha256 are both f608396a, so the committed diff holds no reorder); and the scoped P4-f check passes 44 of 44 while the doctor output holds an error naming scenes/maps/mill.ts (a broken local link in measure/tech-debt.md) and an error naming the scope-map row locations/civic/mill, neither naming the track id (the control clone doctor output holds 51 foreign errors and no line naming scenes/maps/* or locations/civic/*, so no live instance exists; plan.md line 166 claims no error line names the track 'or its files', and the 'or its files' half is unenforced). No probe regressed an existing defense: the control and every expected catch reproduce their exact FAIL lines. The mill rerate record, the TSV, the inventory, and every other committed record were left untouched; every mutation lived in the /tmp clone and was reset after each probe.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-7 [Nit] adversarial-testing: check-records.sh P4-a (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-records.sh:94-116) validates the 4th TSV field but never the column count, so a status cell that ends with a tab adds a fifth column and the gate still passes 44 of 44. Fixture proof: ADV-P4-03b appends one tab to the apothecary row, the row parses as NF=5 with $4=accepted, the diff commits cleanly, and the unmodified checker exits 0 with PASS=44 FAIL=0. No live instance: awk over the committed TSV reports no data row with a column count other than 4. Rationale: the TSV is the acceptance record and its schema is four columns; a stray fifth column is silent schema drift that downstream strict parsers can reject. Red can close it with one awk guard: every data row must hold exactly 4 tab-separated fields.

ADV-8 [Nit] adversarial-testing: check-records.sh P4-b (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-records.sh:118-149) compares the base and head civic P2 scene_id sets as sorted lists and each diff line only by its id, group, and priority prefix, so a pure row reorder inside the civic P2 block passes 44 of 44 while the TSV diff holds structural changes, which the plan claims cannot exist ('the diff changes only the status column', plan.md line 131). Fixture proof: ADV-P4-04a swaps the adjacent apothecary and archive rows, the masked cut -f1-3 sha256 changes from f608396a to 0b771e39, and the unmodified checker exits 0 with PASS=44 FAIL=0. No live instance: the base and head cut -f1-3 sha256 are both f608396a26fe4f37c9b3c4fc4603bd438a35d1eaddad6c7f785cd6039a65ebb4 on the committed tree, so no line moved. Red can close it by comparing the in-order masked sequence (cut -f1-3 sha256 of base against head, as review-a already ran by hand); that one compare also subsumes the non-civic edit case the current per-line check catches.

ADV-9 [Nit] adversarial-testing: check-records.sh P4-f (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-records.sh:255-271) greps the doctor output only for the track id asset_scenes_civic_20260928, so a doctor error that names this track's file or row without the track id passes the scoped gate, and the plan claim 'no error line names asset_scenes_civic_20260928 or its files' (plan.md line 166) is enforced only in its first half. Fixture proof: ADV-P4-07a makes the doctor print 'error: measure/tech-debt.md: broken local link scenes/maps/mill.ts' and ADV-P4-07b makes it print 'error: measure/scope-map.tsv: missing scene row for locations/civic/mill' (a real scope-map row this track owns, dropped); in both runs the doctor error line exists in the output, yet P4-f prints PASS and the checker exits 0 with PASS=44 FAIL=0. No live instance: the control clone doctor output holds 51 foreign error lines and none names scenes/maps/* or locations/civic/*. This extends the file-not-track blindness that review-c F2 noted for the closeout freshness error down into the Phase 4 gate itself. Red can close it by adding the track's civic file paths and scene ids (scenes/maps/<slug>.ts for the 30 slugs, docs/fantasy-world-scene-blueprints.tsv, and locations/civic/*) to the P4-f grep set.
